text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As of today, I'll be taking on the Twinkle
Series
with Daiwa Scarlet!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can barely contain my excitement as I
go to tell
her the good news.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I've collected everyone's assignments.
They're on
your desk.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Oh, thank you! Sorry for the trouble. I'm
sure you
must be busy, what with your
debut coming up
soon...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
No, no, it's my pleasure. Please let me
know if you
need help with anything
else!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, check out the model student!
Wanna take
my class shift while you're at
it?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: With pleasu—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I-I mean, ex-cuse me?! Give me a break, Vodka!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Look at that scowl! So much for
your goody
two-shoes act!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Grrrr!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! How about you drop the
delinquent act,
yourself? You just want
more time to train, don't
you?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Wha—?! No, I don't!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Vodka. Great timing. I have
something I need
to talk to you about.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Serves you right! Now you're going to
get a
lecture!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Well, I suppose that's true in a
sense.
Well? Have you given some
thought to what we
discussed?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You mean about the interview? I dunno,
it's
kinda—

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
A great opportunity, right? "Enter the
rising star! Our number one
up-and-comer!" They've already
reached
out to you, right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ugh, now I really don't wanna do it.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I haven't even debuted yet! I don't
wanna look
like a poser!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Now just wait a—really! That Vodka, I
swear! She
could have at least heard me
out!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Our number one up-and-comer. Not me,
but her...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: N-No, that's not...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Huh? Trainer? Why are you here?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Don't give me that! Idiot!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Um... I heard somebody shouting just
now... Was
that you, Scarlet?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
O-of course not! ♪ It must have been...
someone
else! Come on, Trainer, let's be
on our way! ♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Seriously...
I almost lost my reputation as
a model
student because of you.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Do you think that'll cut it?! Hmph! You
need to
apologize properly!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
So? Since you came all this way to find
me, I
guess it's finally happening, right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: My debut.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I see. Well, we'll both need to work hard
from
here on out. No slacking off, not
even for a
second.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The number one spot is mine. I won't let
anyone
take it from me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
And as for you... I hope you know what
you're
doing. You're my trainer, after all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hmph. I wouldn't settle for anything less.
choice_data_list: I'll make you the number one Umamu...
I will make you the number one Uma...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
All right, Trainer. Let's show the world
who the
real number one is.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Who cares about landing interviews?
Who cares about being a rising star? I'm
the best racer of
them all—and I'm going
to prove it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, my journey to make Daiwa
Scarlet the
number one Umamusume
begins!
